name: School District U-46 High School Magnet Academies
what_you_do: A four-year high school program at one U-46 high school: STEM at Bartlett, IB at Elgin, arts at Larkin, media and digital arts at South Elgin, or leadership and design at Streamwood.
who_can_apply: 8th graders who live in School District U-46, with at least a 2.8 GPA in 7th grade. You must keep a 2.8 GPA through the end of 8th grade to keep your seat.
deadline_text: Application open Oct 1 to Oct 31, 2026, for fall 2027. The lottery runs Nov 9, 2026, and results are emailed that evening.
how_to_apply: A parent or guardian fills out the online application with a personal email. Students new to U-46 add transcripts. Seats go by lottery, with extra entries for things like good attendance, a 3.75 GPA or living near the school.
notes: Students who are homeless or in a temporary living situation get in automatically if they meet the GPA rule. Having a brother or sister in the academy no longer helps. Help: magnetacademies@u-46.org or 847-907-6030.
